UML Deployment Diagram – Hệ thống BrewLite (Local, CI/CD & Production) Repository: https://github.com/giathinhnguyen/brewlite2.git | Next.js Mobile-first/PWA, NestJS, PostgreSQL 16 & Docker Assignment 2: Requirements to Deployment — Khoa CNTT - Đại học Sài Gòn (2026–2027)
<<device>> Thiết bị Người dùng (Customer / Admin Device)
<<executionEnvironment>> Mobile / Desktop Web Browser
<<artifact>> BrewLite Mobile-First Web/PWA (Next.js PWA Client Bundle) Service Worker & Offline Cache
Ranh giới CI/CD Pipeline (GitHub Actions - giathinhnguyen/brewlite2)
<<executionEnvironment>> GitHub Actions Runner CI/CD Workflow (Node 22 / pnpm 12.14.0) 1. Lint & Typecheck ➔ 2. Unit/E2E Test ➔ 3. Build Web/API 4. Prisma Migrate Deploy ➔ 5. Push Image ➔ 6. Smoke Test Secrets: PROD_DATABASE_URL, DEPLOY_HOOK, REGISTRY_TOKEN
<<registry>> GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io/giathinhnguyen)
brewlite2-web tag: <commit-sha>
brewlite2-api tag: <commit-sha>
Dịch vụ Bên ngoài (External Cloud Services)
<<external>> VNPay Sandbox HMAC-SHA512 Webhook IPN & QueryDR (HTTPS :443)
<<external>> VietQR Service img.vietqr.io Quick Link Sinh ảnh QR SVG động
<<external>> Google Identity OAuth 2.0 / ID Token HTTPS :443 Verify
<<external>> Gmail SMTP Server Gửi mã OTP 6 số xác thực SMTPS Port 465 (TLS)
Local Development (docker-compose.yml)
<<device>> Docker Host (Developer PC)
<<container>> Container: brewlite-web Node 22 / Next.js Dev Port: 3001 (Host) ➔ 3000 Hot Module Replacement (HMR)
<<container>> Container: brewlite-api Node 22 / NestJS Server Port: 3000 ➔ Prefix /api GET /api/health (Readiness) Simulator Demo: Enabled
<<database>> Container: brewlite-postgres PostgreSQL 16 (:5432) Healthcheck: pg_isready (5s)
<<volume>> postgres_data 20 bảng + _prisma_migrations
HTTP :3000/api
TCP :5432
Ranh giới Production Environment (Render / Railway Cloud Platform)
Public Edge / CDN Layer
<<cloud>> Edge Web Service brewlite-web (Next.js 14/15 App Router)
Production PWA Bundle • SSR / SSG Menu Caching • Mobile-first Bottom Nav • Guest Cart + syncId Engine • Service Worker PWA Enabled
Runtime Injected Env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID Public Port: HTTPS 443 (TLS 1.3)
Định tuyến Giao diện / (Menu) | /products/[id] /cart | /checkout | /rewards /payments/return | /orders /admin/* (AdminGuard Protected) Pull Image: ghcr.io/giathinhnguyen/brewlite2-web
Private Application VPC (apps/api)
<<container>> Docker (Node 22 Slim) brewlite-api Port 3000 (Private) ➔ HTTPS :443 (Reverse Proxy)
14 Domain Modules (NestJS 12) • Auth (JWT HS256, OTP SMTP, Google Auth) • Products, Toppings, Categories, Inventory (26 items) • Carts, Promotions (Fixed/%), Rewards (Redemption) • Orders (15-min Reservation ACID), Payments (VNPay/QR) • Admin Management & HealthModule (/api/health) Background Worker: Quét giải phóng đơn quá hạn (60s)
Production Secret Store DATABASE_URL (Private SSL connection) JWT_SECRET, WEB_ORIGIN VNPAY_TMN_CODE, VNPAY_HASH_SECRET BANK_TRANSFER_DEMO_ENABLED=false (Disabled in Prod) Logging: stdout/stderr ➔ Cloud Centralized Stream
Prisma Data Access Engine (v6) • Connection Pooling & Query Batching • SELECT FOR UPDATE (Pessimistic Lock trên nguyên liệu) • Idempotency check: checkoutKey, idempotencyKey
Pull Image: ghcr.io/giathinhnguyen/brewlite2-api
Private Database Subnet
<<database>> Managed Instance PostgreSQL 16 Không mở Public Internet Internal TCP Port: 5432
Schema & Migrations • 20 bảng quan hệ (users, orders,...) • 11 enums (OrderStatus, Size,...) • Tiền tệ: Decimal(12, 0) • Định lượng: Decimal(14, 3) • JSONB: reserved_ingredients • Prisma migration deploy an toàn • Idempotent Seed Scripts • Audit Trail: rawResponse, needsReview Health: pg_isready (Internal TCP)
Persistent Storage Volume Đĩa cứng SSD Cloud Enterprise Mount: /var/lib/postgresql/data Snapshot sao lưu tự động hàng ngày Chống thất thoát dữ liệu khi restart
Internal TCP 5432
